pending_user_decision.conflict: All 84 probes are allowed discovery choices, but the same five preselected sealed probes must remain unexecuted in both arms. Unrestricted Active choices can overlap them.
pending_user_decision.recommended_amendment: Precommit an ordered eligible query bank and select its first five probes absent from both discovery ledgers, using only probe identities and no model predictions or post-execution scores. Requires user acceptance because exact five queries become ledger-dependent.
pending_user_decision.alternative: Reserve five fixed sealed probes and remove them from discovery, reducing Active choices to 79. Requires user acceptance because discovery no longer offers all 84.

additional_prospective_requirements: Baseline qualification must hold for the eventual query-selection mechanism, not merely the whole candidate bank.
Last-observation persistence must be weak for arbitrary Active ledgers; nonconstant within-query traces can rule out all constant-state persistence predictions.
Malformed selection handling must be frozen without repairs or retries.
Context, output length and schema qualification must use synthetic fixtures before Method Freeze.
No scientific result may influence method, world selection, prompts or decoding.
